section_1_cloze.passage:
To me, my father, Frank Driscoll, was just a teacher, who seldom spoke of his work. I [41] paid much attention to his profession.

He was always [42] when I needed him, so like most children, I took him for granted. At 65, he retired, and while we frequently talked about my job we rarely touched upon the [43] of his teaching. Even in his final days, I did not [44] him in conversation about his career.

At the funeral (葬礼), I listened as my father's friends shared stories about their time together and what my father [45] to them. I then noticed six young individuals lined up to [46] the guest registry. Initially, I assumed they had [47] arrived at the wrong funeral. I [48] them and politely explained that this was the [49] for Frank Driscoll. One young woman told me they were my father's students a decade ago and wished to pay their [50].

I had never expected my father's students would come. Though I was [51], I invited them into the wake. They shared how my father had significantly influenced their lives. One man recalled how my father [52] him to get a better education as a safety net instead of coasting on his athletic ability. He was grateful later when his athletic career didn't [53] as expected.

Their stories about my father deeply affected me and I now [54] my father in a new light. I will no longer consider him as "just a [55]". He touched the lives of countless young individuals and quietly transformed their futures.

questions.explanation: 前句提到父亲“很少谈论他的工作(seldom spoke of his work)”，后文提到作者把父亲当作理所当然，不知其工作细节。根据句意连贯性，作者“从不(never)”关注父亲的职业。seldom和never在语意上形成递进与呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(luckily)：语境句：Luckily, she survived the terrible traffic accident. 固定搭配：luckily enough, luckily for someone
B(openly)：语境句：They discussed the controversial issue openly and honestly. 固定搭配：speak openly, openly admit
C(often)：语境句：He often stays up late to prepare for the exams. 固定搭配：often than not, as often as
D(never)：语境句：I have never seen such a beautiful sunset in my life. 固定搭配：never mind, never ever

questions.explanation: 因为父亲在我需要他的时候总是“在场/出现(present)”，所以我像大多数孩子一样觉得这是理所当然(took him for granted)。present作形容词指“在场的、出席的”，符合父亲陪伴在身边的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(busy)：语境句：She is always busy preparing lessons for her students. 固定搭配：be busy with, busy oneself with
B(content)：语境句：He is content with his simple but meaningful life. 固定搭配：be content with, content oneself with
C(silent)：语境句：The whole room kept silent when the headmaster entered. 固定搭配：remain silent, fall silent
D(present)：语境句：Every student present in the classroom passed the test. 固定搭配：be present at, at present

questions.explanation: 句意为“我们很少触及他教学的‘话题(subject)’”。touch upon/on the subject of... 是固定表达，意为“触及/谈及……的话题”。
questions.supplement:
A(reflection)：语境句：The article is a deep reflection on human nature. 固定搭配：on reflection, reflection of
B(subject)：语境句：Math is the subject that I find most difficult. 固定搭配：change the subject, touch upon the subject
C(nature)：语境句：We should respect the laws of nature to protect our earth. 固定搭配：by nature, in nature
D(capacity)：语境句：The stadium has a seating capacity of 50,000. 固定搭配：in one's capacity as, capacity for

questions.explanation: 句意见作者甚至在父亲临终前也没有就他的职业与他“交谈/交流”。engage sb. in conversation 意为“与某人攀谈，使某人参与交谈”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(engage)：语境句：Teachers should try to engage students in classroom activities. 固定搭配：engage in, engage someone in conversation
B(monitor)：语境句：The government is setting up a system to monitor air quality. 固定搭配：monitor the situation, closely monitor
C(interrupt)：语境句：It is impolite to interrupt someone when they are speaking. 固定搭配：interrupt a conversation, be interrupted by
D(avoid)：语境句：We should take actions to avoid making the same mistakes. 固定搭配：avoid doing sth, try to avoid

questions.explanation: 句意见“父亲的朋友们分享他们在一起的时光，以及父亲对他们来说‘意味着(meant)’什么”。mean a lot to sb / what sb meant to them 是常见搭配，表达某人对其他人的重要性。
questions.supplement:
A(promised)：语境句：He promised to help me with my English after school. 固定搭配：promise to do, make a promise
B(meant)：语境句：His encouraging words meant a lot to me during hard times. 固定搭配：mean to do, mean doing, mean a lot to
C(lent)：语境句：I lent my bicycle to him because his was broken. 固定搭配：lend sth to sb, lend a hand
D(assigned)：语境句：The teacher assigned a lot of homework for the weekend. 固定搭配：assign sb to do, assign a task

questions.explanation: 在葬礼上，来宾排队在宾客登记簿(guest registry)上“签名(sign)”。符合常理和动作逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(mark)：语境句：Please mark the important points with a red pen. 固定搭配：mark down, leave a mark
B(check)：语境句：Double check your answers before you hand in the paper. 固定搭配：check out, check in
C(copy)：语境句：Don't copy other people's work; try to do it yourself. 固定搭配：copy from, make a copy
D(sign)：语境句：You need to sign your name at the bottom of the document. 固定搭配：sign up, sign a contract

questions.explanation: 起初，作者不知道他们是父亲的学生，所以以为他们是“偶然/不小心(accidentally)”走错了葬礼。
questions.supplement:
A(publicly)：语境句：The company publicly apologized for the poor quality of its products. 固定搭配：publicly announce, state publicly
B(barely)：语境句：He spoke so quietly that I could barely hear him. 固定搭配：barely enough, can barely
C(accidentally)：语境句：I accidentally deleted the file while cleaning my computer. 固定搭配：accidentally discover, happen accidentally
D(specially)：语境句：This dress was specially designed for the upcoming festival. 固定搭配：specially designed, made specially

questions.explanation: 作者以为他们走错了，于是“走近(approached)”他们，礼貌地向他们解释。体现动作的先后连贯性。
questions.supplement:
A(warned)：语境句：The sign warned drivers to slow down near the school. 固定搭配：warn sb of sth, warn against
B(refused)：语境句：He firmly refused the offer because he had other plans. 固定搭配：refuse to do, politely refuse
C(discovered)：语境句：Scientists have discovered a new species of plants in the forest. 固定搭配：discover a way, be discovered by
D(approached)：语境句：As autumn approached, the leaves turned yellow and fell. 固定搭配：approach sb, the approach of

questions.explanation: 结合上一段提到的葬礼(funeral)和后文作者说“I invited them into the wake（守灵）”，可知作者是在向他们解释这是Frank Driscoll的“守灵/葬礼(wake)”。
questions.supplement:
A(wake)：语境句：Friends and family gathered at the wake to comfort each other. 固定搭配：attend a wake, hold a wake
B(celebration)：语境句：They held a grand celebration for the team's victory. 固定搭配：in celebration of, a celebration party
C(gift)：语境句：He has a special gift for learning foreign languages. 固定搭配：a birthday gift, have a gift for
D(comfort)：语境句：The mother's words brought great comfort to the crying child. 固定搭配：in comfort, bring comfort to

questions.explanation: 十年前的学生来参加葬礼，目的是“表达敬意/哀悼(pay their respects)”。pay one's respects (to sb) 是固定搭配，表示“对某人表示敬意，尤指吊唁”。
questions.supplement:
A(claims)：语境句：The insurance company refused to pay his medical claims. 固定搭配：make a claim, lay claim to
B(dues)：语境句：Don't forget to pay your club dues before the end of the month. 固定搭配：pay one's dues, membership dues
C(respects)：语境句：Many citizens went to the memorial to pay their respects to the heroes. 固定搭配：pay one's respects, with respects to
D(debts)：语境句：He worked two jobs in order to pay off his debts. 固定搭配：pay off debts, in debt

questions.explanation: 前句说“我从未想过父亲的学生会来”，所以此处表达作者感到非常“惊讶(astonished)”。虽然惊讶，但还是邀请他们进去。
questions.supplement:
A(excited)：语境句：The children were very excited about the trip to the zoo. 固定搭配：be excited about, get excited
B(astonished)：语境句：I was absolutely astonished to hear that he had won the first prize. 固定搭配：be astonished at/by, be astonished to see
C(confused)：语境句：The complex instructions left the students totally confused. 固定搭配：be confused about, feel confused
D(relieved)：语境句：She felt greatly relieved when she heard her son was safe. 固定搭配：feel relieved, be relieved to hear

questions.explanation: 语境表达父亲说服(persuaded/convinced)这位学生去获得更好的教育作为后路，而不是靠运动天赋混日子。convince sb to do sth意为“说服某人做某事”。此处学生回想起来充满感激，说明是循循善诱，而非强迫(forced)。
questions.supplement:
A(sponsored)：语境句：The local government sponsored the sports event to promote health. 固定搭配：be sponsored by, sponsor a program
B(challenged)：语境句：The puzzle challenged his logical thinking abilities. 固定搭配：challenge sb to do, accept a challenge
C(convinced)：语境句：I finally convinced him to give up smoking for his health. 固定搭配：convince sb of sth, convince sb to do sth
D(forced)：语境句：The heavy rain forced us to cancel the outdoor picnic. 固定搭配：force sb to do, be forced into

questions.explanation: 后来这位学生的运动生涯没有像预期的那样“成功/顺利发展(work out)”，他对此（父亲劝他多受教育）感到很感激。work out表示“（事情）进展顺利，成功”。
questions.supplement:
A(get through)：语境句：I tried calling you, but I couldn't get through. 固定搭配：get through the hard times, get through the exam
B(work out)：语境句：Don't worry, I believe everything will work out in the end. 固定搭配：work out a plan, work out well
C(come up)：语境句：A new problem has come up and needs to be solved immediately. 固定搭配：come up with, come up against
D(break off)：语境句：The two countries decided to break off their diplomatic relations. 固定搭配：break off a relationship, break off a conversation

questions.explanation: 学生的分享深深触动了作者，让作者以全新的眼光“看待/认知(perceive)”父亲。perceive ... in a new light 表示“从新的角度看待……”。
questions.supplement:
A(perceive)：语境句：People perceive the world differently based on their experiences. 固定搭配：perceive as, perceive in a new light
B(forgive)：语境句：It is sometimes hard to forgive those who have hurt us deeply. 固定搭配：forgive sb for doing, ask for forgiveness
C(remember)：语境句：Please remember to turn off the lights when you leave. 固定搭配：remember doing, remember to do
D(introduce)：语境句：Let me introduce you to my best friend, Sarah. 固定搭配：introduce sth to sb, introduce a new policy

questions.explanation: 文章开头提到“was just a teacher”，结尾处呼应首段，作者意识到父亲改变了无数年轻人的未来，决定不再把他仅仅当作“一名教师(teacher)”。
questions.supplement:
A(father)：语境句：He is a strict but loving father to his three children. 固定搭配：a good father, father figure
B(friend)：语境句：A true friend is someone who stays with you in difficult times. 固定搭配：make friends with, close friend
C(coach)：语境句：The coach guided the team to win the national championship. 固定搭配：football coach, head coach
D(teacher)：语境句：A good teacher can inspire hope and ignite the imagination. 固定搭配：school teacher, strict teacher

section_2_word_form.passage:
An exhibition of Chinese mural (壁画) art made its first appearance overseas at the UNESCO headquarters in Paris. The exhibition provided a platform, [56] China, France and international communities had a dialogue on cultural heritage conservation.
This exhibition featured the extraordinary murals from the Yongle Palace, which [57] (locate) in Ruicheng, Shanxi Province. The palace was built during the Yuan Dynasty (1271 - 1368), [58] (serve) as a center of worship (祭祀) during the rule of Emperor Yongle, [59] listed as a national key cultural heritage conservation unit in 1961.
In this exhibition, high technology was used for reproduction and display to let every visitor experience [60] unique charm of these murals up close, which not only exhibited [61] (exception) art skills but also held significant reference value for the study of Chinese thought, art and religious culture. The [62] (integrate) of classical culture and modern technology in the exhibition breathed new life into traditional art forms and made them accessible [63] a global audience.
With the cultural importance of these murals [64] (highlight), the exhibition symbolized the growing interest in China's rich cultural and religious heritage on the global stage and [65] (promote) better understanding and cooperation between countries in a multicultural context.

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构，逗号后为非限制性定语从句，先行词是 platform。从句中主谓宾结构完整（China... had a dialogue），说明缺少关系副词在从句中作地点状语，表示“在这个平台上”，故填 where（或 on which，但纯填词通常填 where）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(where)：语境句：They created an environment where everyone feels respected. 固定搭配：a platform where, situations where。无其它常见变形，注意与 which 的区分。

questions.explanation: 考查被动语态与时态。locate 作“位于”讲时常用于被动语态 be located in/at。描述壁画目前所在的永乐宫的客观地理位置，应使用一般现在时，主语 which 指代单数名词 Yongle Palace，故填 is located。
questions.supplement: 正确形(is located)：语境句：The historic museum is located in the center of the capital. 固定搭配：be located in/on/at。原词locate其它变形：location (n.), locally (adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。The palace 与 serve 之间是逻辑上的主动关系，在此处作伴随或结果状语，故使用现在分词 serving，表示“作为祭祀中心发挥作用”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(serving)：语境句：He spent 10 years serving as the president of the university. 固定搭配：serve as, serve the purpose。原词serve其它变形：service (n.), servant (n.)

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构，“The palace was built..., serving as..., [59] listed as...”。此处 listed 与前文的 built 并列，作 was 的表语/被动语态的一部分（The palace was built ... and was listed ...），省略了前面的 was，因此需要填入并列连词 and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：The building was designed by a famous architect and completed in 2020. 固定搭配：both... and..., and so on。属于基础并列连词。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。experience 的宾语是 unique charm，后面有 of these murals 限定，表示“这些壁画特有的魅力”，属于特指，应使用定冠词 the。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the)：语境句：The beauty of the lake attracts thousands of tourists every year. 固定搭配：the charm of, the importance of。无变形，注意与 a/an (泛指) 的区别。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。此处修饰名词词组 art skills，需要用到 exception 的形容词形式 exceptional，意为“卓越的，非凡的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(exceptional)：语境句：The young musician showed exceptional talent at an early age. 固定搭配：exceptional skills, exceptional talent。原词exception其它变形：except (prep.), exceptionally (adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。位于定冠词 The 和介词 of 之间，作句子的主语，应填入 integrate 的名词形式 integration，表示“古典文化与现代技术的融合”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(integration)：语境句：The integration of theory and practice is vital in education. 固定搭配：the integration of A and B, economic integration。原词integrate其它变形：integrate (v.), integrated (adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查介词。固定搭配 be accessible to sb 意为“对某人来说可接近的/可获取的/可欣赏的”，这里指让全球观众都能接触到这些艺术形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：The new database is easily accessible to all the staff members. 固定搭配：be accessible to, open to。为基础介词搭配考点。

questions.explanation: 考查 with 复合结构 (with + 宾语 + 宾语补足语)。宾语 the cultural importance of these murals 与动词 highlight 之间是被动关系（重要性被凸显），因此使用过去分词 highlighted 作宾补。
questions.supplement: 正确形(highlighted)：语境句：With the main problems highlighted, the team began to seek solutions. 固定搭配：highlight the importance, be highlighted by。原词highlight其它变形：highlight (n./v.原形)

questions.explanation: 考查时态及并列结构。此处与前面的 symbolized 并列，共同作 the exhibition 的谓语动词，叙述已发生的客观事实，因此需用一般过去时 promoted。
questions.supplement: 正确形(promoted)：语境句：The successful campaign promoted global awareness of environmental protection. 固定搭配：promote understanding, promote cooperation。原词promote其它变形：promotion (n.), promoter (n.)
